why_them: The French remarkable-tree association: they label and inventory the trees we map in Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, Strasbourg and Toulouse, and France is our biggest coverage with no contact at all.
France's arboriculture society; their members are the people who assess the veteran planes and cedars we publish in six French cities.
A French remarkable-tree blog we already cite on Bordeaux and Lyon trees; exactly the peer site that links out.
They run Drzewo Roku, Poland's tree of the year, and Poland is five published cities with no contact.
Their drzewa.org.pl work is the Polish tree-protection reference, and we publish trees in Wroclaw, Krakow, Poznan, Warsaw and Gdansk.
They run the Czech tree of the year and its stories, which is the same subject as our pages in Prague and Brno.
We cite this site on eight Prague trees; it is one dendrologist documenting exactly what we publish.
Australia is five published cities with no contact at all, and their members assess the trees on our Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Sydney and Hobart pages.
